title: Delivery evidence link and type
guidance: Render long addresses deliberately so the external-link cue does not dangle on a separate line. Preserve the exact destination and accessible name. Keep Proof/type paint distinct from the global clickable-link tone.

decisions.title: Wrap destinations deliberately without losing them
decisions.reason: The host and path use separate lines, path boundaries offer wrapping points, and an external cue has its own stable column. Full href, title and accessible destination remain intact.

decisions.title: Attachment type is separate from link affordance
decisions.reason: Proof uses a neutral document tag, not the blue information badge. Timestamp is subordinate. Do not clip the link or leave an orphan external arrow.

decisions.title: 1.8 bounded address preview
decisions.reason: The hostname stays visible and the path preview uses at most two lines with ellipsis. The complete address remains in href/title/accessible name and native copy-link/destination behavior. Standard links retain their semantic host/path separation and external icon; attachment tag uses neutral paint.

parameters.name: Link system
parameters.description: Shared across proof list, completion evidence and ordinary inline links.

parameters.name: Markup
parameters.description: evidenceLink validates HTTP(S); attachmentTag is neutral. No binary upload or remote sharing check is implied.
